notes: v2.5.18 - required update. A won quote can now be accepted onto a project that already exists, with builds entered as the numbers the shop actually uses, and the quote page has been rebuilt around it. A customer purchase order can now answer as many change notices as the job really has, and "Changes: None" no longer says so when it is not true. Closing a project or signing off a build is never blocked any more: it is allowed, recorded as an improper close, and carries the signer, a typed reason and a snapshot of what was left unanswered. eBOM templates can finally be edited in AOS, buying a part no longer depends on a healthy CAD server, and the standard-tree fault that gave two seat assemblies the same CAD file is fixed on the template and on the projects it built wrong. Stock is consumed in the unit the floor uses, and the material list is a governed pick list instead of free text, so AE and APM finally read as Ask Engineer and Ask PM. This release also updates the database behind AOS, so please update as soon as you are prompted.
